# artless

> Free of deceit or craftiness, natural, genuine; lacking skill or knowledge, crude, uncultured

> 1. naive; inexperienced 2. plain and simple 3. lacking skill


## Example

- *Despite the president's seemingly artless speeches, he was a skilled and ruthless negotiator.*
